from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCash(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported in one company's financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the document")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents amount as reported in the document")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    field_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact line item name from the balance sheet")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Period end date as reported (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the cash amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_reports: list[CompanyCash]
